snippet.title: Fearwoods – Co-Op Multiplayer Horror
snippet.description:
SSome forests don’t let you leave.

Fearwoods is currently in Close Alpha / Early Beta – an early development phase before Early Access. What you’re seeing is active work in progress gameplay.

We’re inviting players to help shape the experience.

Fearwoods is a multiplayer psychological horror game where survival depends on teamwork, awareness… and silence. Explore a cursed forest filled with dynamic objectives, unpredictable demon encounters, and abandoned locations hiding dark secrets.

Every session is different.
GPS fragments spawn in new locations.
The asylum isn’t safe.
The demon adapts.

This stage is focused on:
testing core mechanics
improving spawn balance
refining enemy behavior
polishing atmosphere and tension
gathering real player feedback

👥 Want to help test the game?
💬 Share your feedback.
🛠️ Help us improve Fearwoods before Early Access.
🎮 Wishlist Fearwoods on Steam and follow development:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4025550/Fearwoods_Demo/
